rules.name: ValidLocation
rules.message: Resource location should be one of: eastus, westus, or centralus.

rules.name: ValidSize
rules.message: Resource size should be one of: Standard_DS1_v2 or Standard_DS2_v2.

rules.name: ValidResourceGroup
rules.message: Resource group name must follow alphanumeric, underscore, or hyphen conventions.

rules.name: ValidIPRange
rules.message: Firewall IP range must be a valid CIDR range.
